primary: Deepest interior localminimum of matchedAsimov A90/B0 in each2–8sigma flank; if none choose deepest gridpoint and flag boundary
extent: Contiguous integergrid points with ratio<=.9 in sameflank around chosenminimum; no interpolation
toy_summary: Each toyminimum in sameflank plus all20ratios evaluated at the fixed matchedAsimov minimum; quantiles descriptive, not confidence intervals
additional_dips: All integergrid local minima with ratio<=.9 outside2sigma, including farther than8sigma; explicitly exploratory and distinct from primarypair
absent_flank: outside_scan status with blank numericcells; no extrapolated landmark
